State-run water utility (reservoirs + distribution) covering ~2M residents. Heavy OT/SCADA environment; strict network zones. Prospect wants fully air-gapped Private deployment for operator-assist and incident triage. Key technical asks: p99 latency target <200ms for SCADA alert reranking, deterministic behavior for operator workflows, HSM-backed KMS, offline installer & hardware image, FIPS-like crypto, and long retention/audit logs for regulatory reports. Preference: CAPEX on-prem license + annual support (less appetite for hosted OPEX).

Export-control & ITAR-style review flagged by procurement (internal). OT team has legacy CentOS images; compatibility validation required.

Commercials: looking for annualized support + optional onsite install. Potential ARR band $250k-$750k depending on support level and number of isolated sites.
